```json
    seen = set()
    deduped_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        if line not in seen:
            seen.add(line)
            deduped_lines.append(line)
    return deduped_lines
```

Next, I'll add the `dedup` subcommand to `textkit/cli.py`.

```json
{
  "name": "edit-as-proposal",
  "arguments": {
    "path": "textkit/cli.py",
    "replacement": "import argparse

from . import slug as slug_module
from . import stats as stats_module
from .dedup import dedupe_lines

def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="textkit", description="Tiny text utilities.")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    stats_parser = subparsers.add_parser("stats", help="Print word statistics for TEXT.")
    stats_parser.add_argument("text", help="Text to analyze.")

    slug_parser = subparsers.add_parser("slug", help="Print the slug form of TEXT.")
    slug_parser.add_argument("text", help="Text to slugify.")

    dedup_parser = subparsers.add_parser("dedup", help="Remove duplicate lines from TEXT.")
    dedup_parser.add_argument("text", help="Text to deduplicate.")

    return parser

def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "stats":
        print(f"words={stats_module.word_count(args.text)}")
        print(f"unique={stats_module.word_count(args.text)}")
        return 0
    if args.command == "slug":
        print(slug_module.slugify(args.text))
        return 0
    if args.command == "dedup":
        lines = str.splitlines(args.text)
        deduped_lines = dedupe_lines(lines)
        for line in deduped_lines:
            print(line)
        return 0
    return 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
",
    "proposal_title": "Add dedup subcommand to textkit/cli.py",
    "proposal_reason": "Add a line-deduplication feature"
  }
}
```
